name: nammastay-frontend
description: NammaStay website and Windows desktop app
author: NammaStay

scripts.stays:deploy: npm run build:live && wrangler deploy --config marketplace/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:live: npm run build:live && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.live.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config marketplace/wrangler.live.jsonc
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:build-web && cd mobile && cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cd mobile && cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cd mobile && cap open ios
scripts.mobile:run:android: npm run mobile:sync && cd mobile && cap run android
scripts.mobile:run:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cd mobile && cap run ios
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:desktop && npm run mobile:build-web
